results.body:
new MockServerClient("localhost", <port>)
.when(
        request()
                .withMethod("GET")
                .withPath("/cc-fwdresp/sse")
                .withHeaders(
                        new Header("accept", "text/event-stream"),
                        new Header("x-test", "sse"),
                        new Header("x-echo-server-port", "<port>"),
                        new Header("host", "localhost:<port>")
                )
                .withSecure(false)
                .withKeepAlive(true)
                .withProtocol(Protocol.HTTP_1_1),
        Times.once(),
        TimeToLive.unlimited(),
        0
)
.respond(
        response()
                .withHeaders(
                        new Header("x-response-test", "x-response-test"),
                        new Header("Content-Type", "text/event-stream"),
                        new Header("x-mockserver-response-time-ms", "<ms>")
                )
                .withBody("some_overidden_response_body")
);

new MockServerClient("localhost", <port>)
.when(
        request()
                .withMethod("GET")
                .withPath("/t-sse-override-and-patch")
                .withHeaders(
                        new Header("accept", "text/event-stream"),
                        new Header("host", "localhost:<port>")
                )
                .withSecure(false)
                .withKeepAlive(true)
                .withProtocol(Protocol.HTTP_1_1),
        Times.once(),
        TimeToLive.unlimited(),
        0
)
.respond(
        response()
                .withStatusCode(200)
                .withReasonPhrase("OK")
                .withHeaders(
                        new Header("Content-Type", "text/event-stream"),
                        new Header("X-Extra", "e"),
                        new Header("x-mockserver-streamed", "true"),
                        new Header("x-mockserver-chunk-delays-ms", "0,<ms>,<ms>,<ms>"),
                        new Header("x-mockserver-response-time-ms", "<ms>")
                )
                .withBody("data: one\n\ndata: two\n\n")
);
